title: Merge paid jobs in the native word under the rebalanced retirement tree (κ 0.00329700)
body:
## Result

Conditional on the five inherited framework assumptions; the selected frontier is unchanged.

## What changes

The PR6551 caller (PR6545 retirement, child trees (7,2,5,4)) is kept as is. The PR6529 native word gets three compensated edits (event numbers in the 18,493-event PR6529 word; the new word has 18,561):

- **A. Paid-job merge.** The single-use owned register 770 (created at event 9191, carried through frames 549, 553, 1047, 593) now goes straight from frame 549 to 593. Six rows (119, 169, 191, 193, 204, 206) receive `r471 + r525/2 + 2 r704` as 18 ADDs in frame 3 at program start; rows 9 and 61 take compensating ADDs in frame 127. Paid jobs of ranks 1, 1, 1, 3 become one job of rank 6.
- **B. Register 471.** Its addition is re-based: `+r174`, `-r257/2` in frame 3 (events 2557, 5664), compensated in frame 676 (events 9677 to 9679), replacing `2 r770` in frame 593.
- **C. Helper 435.** Its input moves from frame 127 to frame 246; the preparation is done in frame 3 and compensated in frame 516, with a shadow register 783 created and cleared in frame 127. One rank-9 target becomes rank 8 and one rank-5 paid job rank 4.

Per native call: paid {1:-3, 3:-1, 4:+1, 5:-1, 6:+1}, targets {8:+1, 9:-1}. Complete signed invoice gain over PR6551 (18 calls):

```text
18 * (3 H1 + H3 + H5 + H8 - H4 - H6 - H9)
```

For `H_r = r^t`, `0 < t < 1`: `(3H1 + H3 - H6) > 0` by strict subadditivity, and `(H5 - H4) - (H9 - H8) > 0` because the derivative strictly decreases. Productive fields stay 13,756, paid jobs fall 67,096 to 67,042, rank-mass surplus stays 760. The shadow register 783 is erased nonzero like 781, under the existing `owned_erasure` assumption.
